test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Only three people sit between E and F when counted from the left of E. Only three people sit between G and D when counted from the right of D. A sits to the immediate right of G. C is an immediate neighbour of D as well as F.

Who sits second to the left of B?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) Only three people sit between G and D when counted from the right of D. 

2) A sits to the immediate right of G. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc2e1eebeaf8e279190c39afeeb48b02a4c52e9353fafc7672b27608ba52dc81.png] 

3) C is an immediate neighbour of D as well as F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31b94b6033b17d3e7cd9e41319cb26d5b5e721d355b3977ddbb83e8ae2a946d8.png] 

4) Only three people sit between E and F when counted from the left of E. 

After positioning E only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45ff4c1f27129902eee70dfc5266e9ad62748cf4f7890b94362b01c93e501014.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement C sits second to the left of B.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
